_meta.title: Content analysis of the reading-room books (measured from OCR full text)
_meta.method: Downloaded the Internet Archive djVu OCR text and counted register lexicons per 1,000 words. Indicative classification, not a definitive one — OCR is noisy and lexicons are hand-built. Shown so you can see WHAT KIND of book this is, empirically, before you read it.

in.ernet.dli.2015.147284.title: My Days with Nehru
in.ernet.dli.2015.147284.verdict: An insider MEMOIR, not a history. Administrative, political and personal content run in near-equal measure (~8–9 per 1,000 words each), but the first-person voice is far denser (16.9/1k) — this is one man's vantage, and the personal/gossip register is as heavy as the politics. Read as testimony, weighed, not as neutral record.
